caption:
The video captures a tight close-up of an electric guitar body with a tortoiseshell pickguard, a chrome-covered single-coil pickup, brass bridge saddles, and a black microphone-stand clamp at the left edge. The player's picking hand is already sweeping across the strings over the bridge pickup. It appears motion-blurred on fast passes and steadier on others. The fingers grip a small green pick, which flashes between strokes as the hand hovers and strikes the strings repeatedly.

As the picking continues, the working position drifts toward the neck pickup, and the view itself re-centers, dropping to reveal a white control plate with a black toggle tip and a round knob along the bottom. The hand disappears briefly from frame, then re-enters over the slanted silver pickup cover. It is blurred again on quick passes and steadier when the green pick is held between the fingers.

Throughout, the strumming remains an ongoing process, the hand cycling over the strings without a clear start or finish.
